prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Shape Your Pet's Personality", "Select Personality Traits"]
1: ["Try Moving and Talking to Your Desktop Pet", "Click and drag your companion across your desktop or send a quick greeting to see how it responds.", "Complete Onboarding"]
2: ["Choose an Instant Starter Companion or Create Custom", "Select Express Starter Pet"]
3: ["Choose Your Desktop Vibe", "Select Companion Archetype"]
4: ["Your Companion is Ready + First Day Gift Unlocked!", "Unlocked: Golden Desktop Toy Accessory"]
5: ["Sign In to Secure Your Custom Desktop Pet", "Keep your pet safe and synced across desktop reboots and devices."]
6: ["Generating Your Pet... We Will Notify You When Ready!"]
7: ["A Daily Companion Built Right Into Your Workspace", "Choose whether you want a calm co-working buddy, an encouraging productivity guide, or a playful desk pet."]
8: ["Official Custom Engraved Name Collar", "Engrave Pet Collar Name"]
9: ["Your Pet is Getting Ready!", "Preview Companion Sounds", "Companion Desktop Fun Facts"]

verdicts.problem: Mentions gifts or free extra items
